intro.title: Touching the Future
intro.subtitle: CAPI CAREER PATH SIMULATOR
intro.blurb: Capi will scan your way of thinking through 17 quick questions, drop you into a 20-question simulation mission, and decode your Capi-Gene — your career signature.
intro.new_title: You have been summoned to the Capi Research Institute
intro.new_blurb: Welcome to the Capi Research Institute! I am Capi, your assistant. Before stepping into the virtual reality simulation gates, let me run a preliminary scan on your thinking system. Ready?
intro.footer_hint: Complete the first scan to unlock virtual reality simulation gates.
intro.scan_intro_blurb: You will answer 15 questions on a 1-5 scale. Please choose based on what you actually do, not what you think is the "correct choice".
intro.login_modal_desc: Log in to save your test results and review them anytime!
intro.hero_blurb: A situational simulation experience in the STEAM world. You make choices - and discover your standout strengths.
intro.sec2_title: Three perspectives on the same person:
intro.sec2_subtitle: Capi Gene does not grade answers. It captures three cross-sections across three moments — before, during, and after you navigate challenges — then compares them together.
intro.card1_quote: “Before starting, who do I think I am?”
intro.card1_desc: You begin from how you currently see yourself.
intro.card2_quote: “When challenges actually happen, what will I do?”
intro.card2_desc: The choices you make gradually reveal how you approach and solve problems.
intro.card3_quote: “After the experience, do I still see myself the same way?”
intro.card3_desc: You look back at yourself to see if your initial perspective shifted.
intro.sec2_callout_title: The beauty isn't in finding a "correct" answer.
intro.sec2_callout_desc: It lies in the distance between the three slices: does how you think about yourself match how you actually act — and after the experience, does that perspective shift?
intro.sec3_subtitle: In every challenge, people contribute differently. Capi Career identifies 5 core Capi Genes representing strengths and orientations:
intro.sec3_callout_title: You don't necessarily have just one Capi Gene.
intro.sec3_callout_desc: Everyone carries multiple Genes. The simulation reveals which Genes stand out and how they synergize in your decisions.
intro.sec4_title: Ready to discover your Capi Gene?
intro.sec4_step1_desc: Answer as you actually think and act, not what you assume is the "best" answer.
intro.sec4_step2_desc: Every choice unveils a unique perspective on your natural strengths.
intro.sec4_step3_desc: Don't overthink. Your immediate instinct is usually the most genuine.
intro.sec4_note: The goal is not boxing you into a Gene, but discovering how different Capi Genes manifest within you.
